entries.text:
**Overall:** Caroline and Melanie (“Mel”) are close, supportive friends. Caroline is a trans woman (transitioning since ~2020; from Sweden; moved countries ~4 years before June 2023). She pursues adoption via an LGBTQ+-inclusive agency (applied 23 Aug 2023; contacted mentor 13 Oct; passed adoption agency interviews last Friday, reported 22 Oct 2023). Ready to be a mom; wants to create a safe, loving home for kids, give back, and show love/acceptance. Volunteers at an LGBTQ+ youth center, mentors LGBTQ youth, joined Connected LGBTQ Activists, wants counseling/mental-health work, advocacy, mentorship. Pets: guinea pig Oscar. Loves piano, acoustic guitar (~5 years; emotional expression), painting/drawing (since ~17; helped during transition), reading (“Becoming Nicole”), horseback riding with dad as a child. Values LGBTQ+ community, friends/family/mentors, grandma’s cross-and-heart necklace from Sweden, friend’s hand-painted bowl. Melanie has been married 5 years (as of June 2023), has kids, values family; pets dog Luna, cats Oliver and Bailey (new 23 Aug 2023); enjoys pottery, painting, running, reading, violin, live music; plays clarinet since childhood; art 7 years. Melanie’s friend adopted last year—long process but happy; Melanie may consider adoption too. Melanie had an injury last month, took a break from pottery; doing okay, reading book Caroline recommended and painting; shared sunset painting (pink sky, calming) and blue abstract painting (tranquility/serene/vibrant). Caroline is trying abstract art; attended a transgender poetry reading last Friday (powerful, safe, empowering; poster “trans lives matter”; drew woman in dress = freedom/being real). On 20 Oct: Melanie’s family roadtrip had a bad start—her son was in a car accident; all scared but son okay. Life is precious/cherish family; family means the world, biggest motivation/support; kids were scared but resilient. They enjoyed Grand Canyon; hiked; nature/camping helps her reset/recharge, brings peace/serenity. Later 20 Oct 6:55 pm: Melanie values being present/together; stories, campfires, nature; waking to birds/fresh air refreshes her soul. Caroline calls it peaceful/calming and says quality tranquil family time is great. Melanie says nature/quality time can’t be beat; Caroline says priceless, “Lucky you!” On 22 Oct 9:55 am: Caroline passed adoption agency interviews last Friday; excited/thankful; big move toward family goal. Melanie congratulates her; adoption sounds awesome; happy. Melanie bought wooden dolls/figurines yesterday that remind her of family love; asks Caroline’s vision. Caroline: love is in families, both blood and chosen; hopes to build her own family and put a roof over kids who haven’t had that; adoption is giving back/showing love and acceptance. Melanie: giving a home to needy kids is a loving way to build a family; kids will be supported/happy. Caroline: dream is a safe and loving home; love/acceptance should be everyone’s right. Melanie agrees; passionate about helping kids. Caroline: finding self-acceptance was long; now ready to offer love/support; empowering to make a positive difference. Melanie respects her; strong/inspiring. Caroline: transitioning/acceptance wasn’t easy; help from friends, family, and mentors was invaluable; wants to pass that support on; bringing comfort and helping others grow brings joy. Melanie happy/inspiring. Caroline thanks her; support means a lot; journey amazing; grateful to share/help others; shared image of clock with green/yellow design. Melanie: glad they can always be there for each other. Caroline appreciates close support/encouragement. Melanie: being yourself is great. Caroline: freeing to be yourself/live honestly/content; shared painting with words “happiness.”

**Key timeline:**
- **8 May 2023:** Caroline at LGBTQ support group; inspired/accepted; plans counseling. Melanie busy with kids/work; shared lake-sunrise painting.
- **25 May 2023:** Melanie ran mental-health charity race; self-care running/reading/violin. Caroline researching LGBTQ+-inclusive adoption; single parenthood tough; Melanie encouraged.
- **9 June 2023:** Caroline spoke at school about trans journey; 3 years since transition; inclusion/vulnerability; tough breakup; friends/family/mentors helped. Melanie proud; married 5 years; “family is everything.”
- **27 June 2023:** Caroline shared grandma’s necklace and friend’s bowl; attended LGBTQ+ counseling workshop. Melanie camping in mountains.
- **3 July 2023:** Caroline at Pride parade; wants counseling/mental-health; learning piano. Melanie signed up pottery class; shared pottery bowl.
- **6 July 2023:** Caroline exploring counseling/mental health. Melanie took kids to museum.
- **12 July 2023:** Caroline at LGBTQ conference (trans rights/awareness). Melanie shared book cover; pets Luna/Oliver; running longer. Caroline favorite book “Becoming Nicole.”
- **15 July 2023:** Melanie busy; kids pottery workshop; paintings. Caroline adoption council meeting; wedding/pride photos; transition freeing. Mutual support.
- **17 July 2023:** Caroline joined LGBTQ youth mentorship; mentors trans teen; Pride event; next month LGBTQ art show. Melanie praised; kids finished painting.
- **20 July 2023:** Caroline joined Connected LGBTQ Activists (~18 July). Melanie beach trip with kids; camping tradition; Perseid meteor shower; youngest first steps; beach-sunset photo. Caroline shared baby crib photo.
- **14 Aug 2023:** Melanie at daughter’s birthday/Matt Patterson concert; “all are welcome.” Caroline advocacy event/Pride parade; art “Embracing Identity” (self-acceptance/imperfections). Melanie: art healing; shared pottery.
- **17 Aug 2023:** Caroline’s hike marred by religious conservatives’ upsetting comments; LGBTQ rights work remains. Melanie supportive; shared bowls/art. Agreed to plan family outing/two-person trip; Caroline: “Life’s all about creating memories.”
- **23 Aug 2023:** Caroline applied to adoption agencies; first step to becoming mom; excited/nerve-wracking; got adoption advice. Melanie proud; got cat Bailey; Oliver hid bone; horse carrot. Caroline used to ride with dad; loves horses. Shared self-portrait (blue face); liberated/empowered; art helps identity/therapy; wants live authentically/help others.
- **25 Aug 2023:** Caroline’s hike bad spot; tried to apologize. Melanie: courageous/mature. Melanie made floral pottery plate; volunteered at homeless shelter with family. Caroline shared sunset/ocean paintings; rainbow-flag mural (courage/strength; eagle=freedom/resilience); stained glass (person on horse, person with key, church windows; made for local church—growth/change/true potential). Melanie asked about transition/community; praised. Caroline shared rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month (togetherness/differences); flower drawing/watercolor. Melanie: art in unlikely places; shared sunflower painting. Caroline organizing LGBTQ art show next month; features LGBTQ artists, spreads understanding/acceptance.
- **28 Aug 2023:** Melanie took kids to park. Caroline volunteered at LGBTQ+ youth center; shared story so youth feel not alone; powerful/emotional; will continue; next helping kids’ talent show next month. Melanie loves live music; “Summer Sounds” show; music brings people together. Caroline plays acoustic guitar ~5 years; cathartic; meaningful song “Brave” by Sara Bareilles. Melanie plays clarinet since young; favorites Bach/Mozart/Ed Sheeran “Perfect.”
- **13 Sep 2023, 12:09 am:** Caroline had great day with gang last weekend—biking, refreshing; shared beach/fence/sunset photo. Melanie shared camping with kids few weeks ago: forest, hiking, marshmallows, campfire stories; photo dirt road/yellow leaves. Caroline loves cozy leaves; kids’ excitement contagious. Melanie: simple moments/parenting worth it; asked what inspires Caroline’s volunteering. Caroline: making difference for LGBTQ+ community/creating loving world; thankful for friends/family/mentors; art inspired; shared heart painting. Melanie asked how long making art. Caroline: since ~17; empowering/cathartic; art expresses hard-to-say things. Melanie: art 7 years; painting/pottery muses; shared bowls/starfish. Caroline praised; painting/drawing helped express feelings/explore gender identity and accept herself during transition. Melanie: art as outlet/therapy; asked if Caroline tried pottery. Caroline hasn’t but open; shared red/blue easel painting. Melanie asked idea. Caroline: red/blue = binary gender system; mix = smashing rigid thinking; reminder to love authentic self; finally proud. Melanie proud; asked effect on relationships. Caroline: some close friends supported, a few couldn’t handle it; not easy but happier around accepting/loving people; relationships more

**Overall:** Caroline and Melanie (“Mel”) are close, supportive friends. Caroline is a trans woman (transitioning since ~2020; from Sweden; moved countries ~4 years before June 2023). She pursues adoption via an LGBTQ+-inclusive agency (applied 23 Aug 2023; contacted mentor 13 Oct; passed adoption agency interviews last Friday, reported 22 Oct 2023). Ready to be a mom; wants to create a safe, loving home for kids, give back, and show love/acceptance. Volunteers at an LGBTQ+ youth center, mentors LGBTQ youth, joined Connected LGBTQ Activists, wants counseling/mental-health work, advocacy, mentorship. Pets: guinea pig Oscar. Loves piano, acoustic guitar (~5 years; emotional expression), painting/drawing (since ~17; helped during transition), reading (“Becoming Nicole”), horseback riding with dad as a child. Values LGBTQ+ community, friends/family/mentors, grandma’s cross-and-heart necklace from Sweden, friend’s hand-painted bowl. Melanie has been married 5 years (as of June 2023), has kids, values family; pets dog Luna, cats Oliver and Bailey (new 23 Aug 2023); enjoys pottery, painting, running, reading, violin, live music; plays clarinet since childhood; art 7 years. Melanie’s friend adopted last year—long process but happy; Melanie may consider adoption too. Melanie had an injury last month, took a break from pottery; doing okay, reading book Caroline recommended and painting; shared sunset painting (pink sky, calming) and blue abstract painting (tranquility/serene/vibrant). Caroline is trying abstract art; attended a transgender poetry reading last Friday (powerful, safe, empowering; poster “trans lives matter”; drew woman in dress = freedom/being real). On 20 Oct: Melanie’s family roadtrip had a bad start—her son was in a car accident; all scared but son okay. Life is precious/cherish family; family means the world, biggest motivation/support; kids were scared but resilient. They enjoyed Grand Canyon; hiked; nature/camping helps her reset/recharge, brings peace/serenity. Later 20 Oct 6:55 pm: Melanie values being present/together; stories, campfires, nature; waking to birds/fresh air refreshes her soul. Caroline calls it peaceful/calming and says quality tranquil family time is great. Melanie says nature/quality time can’t be beat; Caroline says priceless, “Lucky you!” On 22 Oct 9:55 am: Caroline passed adoption agency interviews last Friday; excited/thankful; big move toward family goal. Melanie congratulates her; adoption sounds awesome; happy. Melanie bought wooden dolls/figurines yesterday that remind her of family love; asks Caroline’s vision. Caroline: love is in families, both blood and chosen; hopes to build her own family and put a roof over kids who haven’t had that; adoption is giving back/showing love and acceptance. Melanie: giving a home to needy kids is a loving way to build a family; kids will be supported/happy. Caroline: dream is a safe and loving home; love/acceptance should be everyone’s right. Melanie agrees; passionate about helping kids. Caroline: finding self-acceptance was long; now ready to offer love/support; empowering to make a positive difference. Melanie respects her; strong/inspiring. Caroline: transitioning/acceptance wasn’t easy; help from friends, family, and mentors was invaluable; wants to pass that support on; bringing comfort and helping others grow brings joy. Melanie happy/inspiring. Caroline thanks her; support means a lot; journey amazing; grateful to share/help others; shared image of clock with green/yellow design. Melanie: glad they can always be there for each other. Caroline appreciates close support/encouragement. Melanie: being yourself is great. Caroline: freeing to be yourself/live honestly/content; shared painting with words “happiness.”

**Key timeline:**
- **8 May 2023:** Caroline at LGBTQ support group; inspired/accepted; plans counseling. Melanie busy with kids/work; shared lake-sunrise painting.
- **25 May 2023:** Melanie ran mental-health charity race; self-care running/reading/violin. Caroline researching LGBTQ+-inclusive adoption; single parenthood tough; Melanie encouraged.

- **15 July 2023:** Melanie busy; kids pottery workshop; paintings. Caroline adoption council meeting; wedding/pride photos; transition freeing. Mutual support.
- **17 July 2023:** Caroline joined LGBTQ youth mentorship; mentors trans teen; Pride event; next month LGBTQ art show. Melanie praised; kids finished painting.
- **20 July 2023:** Caroline joined Connected LGBTQ Activists (~18 July). Melanie beach trip with kids; camping tradition; Perseid meteor shower; youngest first steps; beach-sunset photo. Caroline shared baby crib photo.

- **17 Aug 2023:** Caroline’s hike marred by religious conservatives’ upsetting comments; LGBTQ rights work remains. Melanie supportive; shared bowls/art. Agreed to plan family outing/two-person trip; Caroline: “Life’s all about creating memories.”
- **23 Aug 2023:** Caroline applied to adoption agencies; first step to becoming mom; excited/nerve-wracking; got adoption advice. Melanie proud; got cat Bailey; Oliver hid bone; horse carrot. Caroline used to ride with dad; loves horses. Shared self-portrait (blue face); liberated/empowered; art helps identity/therapy; wants live authentically/help others.
- **25 Aug 2023:** Caroline’s hike bad spot; tried to apologize. Melanie: courageous/mature. Melanie made floral pottery plate; volunteered at homeless shelter with family. Caroline shared sunset/ocean paintings; rainbow-flag mural (courage/strength; eagle=freedom/resilience); stained glass (person on horse, person with key, church windows; made for local church—growth/change/true potential). Melanie asked about transition/community; praised. Caroline shared rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month (togetherness/differences); flower drawing/watercolor. Melanie: art in unlikely places; shared sunflower painting. Caroline organizing LGBTQ art show next month; features LGBTQ artists, spreads understanding/acceptance.
- **28 Aug 2023:** Melanie took kids to park. Caroline volunteered at LGBTQ+ youth center; shared story so youth feel not alone; powerful/emotional; will continue; next helping kids’ talent show next month. Melanie loves live music; “Summer Sounds” show; music brings people together. Caroline plays acoustic guitar ~5 years; cathartic; meaningful song “Brave” by Sara Bareilles. Melanie plays clarinet since young; favorites Bach/Mozart/Ed Sheeran “Perfect.”
- **13 Sep 2023, 12:09 am:** Caroline had great day with gang last weekend—biking, refreshing; shared beach/fence/sunset photo. Melanie shared camping with kids few weeks ago: forest, hiking, marshmallows, campfire stories; photo dirt road/yellow leaves. Caroline loves cozy leaves; kids’ excitement contagious. Melanie: simple moments/parenting worth it; asked what inspires Caroline’s volunteering. Caroline: making difference for LGBTQ+ community/creating loving world; thankful for friends/family/mentors; art inspired; shared heart painting. Melanie asked how long making art. Caroline: since ~17; empowering/cathartic; art expresses hard-to-say things. Melanie: art 7 years; painting/pottery muses; shared bowls/starfish. Caroline praised; painting/drawing helped express feelings/explore gender identity and accept herself during transition. Melanie: art as outlet/therapy; asked if Caroline tried pottery. Caroline hasn’t but open; shared red/blue easel painting. Melanie asked idea. Caroline: red/blue = binary gender system; mix = smashing rigid thinking; reminder to love authentic self; finally proud. Melanie proud; asked effect on relationships. Caroline: some close friends supported, a few couldn’t handle it; not easy but happier around accepting/loving people; relationships more

Speakers: Nate and Joanna (“Jo”). Rolling summary.

Core: Jo writes screenplays/books; loves reading, movies, nature/hiking, journaling, memories, dairy-free baking. Severe pet allergy (reptiles/furry/cockroaches); had dog Tilly in Michigan but gave her away; keeps stuffed dog Nate gave, named Tilly, always with her while writing. Nate pro gamer (CS:GO, Valorant, Street Fighter, Nintendo RPGs), has turtles (now 3), loves dairy-free desserts, purple hair, Iron Man, Tampa. Mutual support; Jo gives movie recs; Nate encourages writing.

Timeline highlights:
- Jan-Feb 2022 (D1-D4): reconnected. Nate won first CS:GO tournament; Jo not into games. Jo writes/reads/movies/nature; Nate games/movies. Nate action/sci-fi/classics; Jo dramas/romcoms. Jo finished first full screenplay (drama/romance), plans festivals. Nate has turtles; recommends pets for stress. Jo severe pet allergy. Nate chill at tournaments, cheers even if loses. Nate discovered coconut milk ice cream; made dairy-free chocolate cake with berries. Jo dairy-free. Jo started script: 30-year-old woman’s self-discovery after loss, inspired by own story, road trip to heal/grow; Nate called deep.
- Mar-Apr (D5-D9): Jo wrapped 2nd script; audition for writing gig; joined writers group; script “Finding Home.” Nate tournaments; dyed hair purple. Turtles low-maintenance/calming; walking them reminds enjoy small stuff. Jo wished not allergic; would get two. Jo nature/hiking haven; found hometown trail. Nate: find peace/remember life’s beauty; pets/hobbies break reality. Jo writing advice: read lots, try genres, don’t fear writing/sharing, practice/feedback, follow dreams.
- May-Jun (D10-D15): Jo watched LOTR after Nate rec; hiking at Whispering Falls; wrote bits for screenplay shown on big screen. Nate won 2nd tournament; tried local Street Fighter; loves dairy-free desserts. Jo testing dairy-free desserts. Jo loves Spider-Man/Peter Parker; Nate Iron Man. Jo’s room: inspiring quotes/pictures.
- Jul-Aug (D17-D18): Nate won 4th online video game tournament; proud to make money doing what he loves. Jo road trip research to Woodhaven (small Midwest town: scenery, historic buildings, old library 1900s book stories/sketches) sparked next script; started book on loss/redemption/forgiveness. Nate: real-life stories best inspiration; sure she’ll be recognized as published movie author. Jo busy writing highs/lows; journal rock; words magical/healing; blog reader letter touched her. Nate teaching dairy-free dessert; offered creamy recipe; Jo would try/surprise family.
- Oct 2022 (D22-D25): D22 6 Oct: Jo’s raspberry tart dairy-free recipe winner; Nate won big video game tournament, made much money. D24 21 Oct: Nate stressed; turtles cheer him. Jo still has stuffed dog Tilly, helps focus/joy; real Tilly given away due allergy. Jo had rejection from production company; Nate: rejections don’t define her, keep at it, opportunity will come; Jo won’t slow down. D25 25 Oct: Jo contributed to another movie script shown on big screen; surreal/satisfying; shared drawing book of character visuals. Nate took turtles for walk; turtles eat vegetables/fruits/insects; loves seeing them hyped on strawberries.
- Nov 2022:
  - D26 4 Nov: details unavailable/truncated.
  - D27 7 Nov: Nate won final of big Valorant tournament last Saturday; best feeling seeing name as champion. Jo finished producer presentation last Friday—tough but looking good. Nate preparing other tournaments, busy/loving it; grateful for job. Jo writing another movie script—love story with challenges from a dream; submitted a few scripts last week; hopes at least one becomes her 3rd published movie. Nate upgraded home equipment (desk/monitor, headphones/controller). Jo asks favorite game; Nate playing fantasy RPG “Xeonoblade Chronicles,” recommends it; big Nintendo fan. Nate loves Jo’s movie recs more than random. Jo included handwritten letter from her brother as a kid in next script; sweet childhood memories. Nate: childhood memories powerful. Jo started writing favorite memories down. Nate will write down things animals like and favorite memories with Jo.
  - D28 9 Nov: Nate’s tournament pushed back; made homemade coconut ice cream, sprinkles changed color. Jo couldn’t try due dairy. Nate didn’t make finals; considering joining new gaming team after next tourney (offers, undecided). Jo: switch could open opportunities. Jo pitched another script to producers yesterday; they really liked it, big confidence boost. Jo’s new project: suspenseful thriller set in small Midwestern town; inspired by sunset hike near Fort Wayne last summer. Nate got third turtle; turtles bring joy/peace, tank big enough. Jo asked to come over and watch him play with them from a distance due allergy; Nate agreed, maybe watch her movie or park; will bathe turtles before. Jo: see you tomorrow. Nate: Bye Joanna.
  - D29 11 Nov 2022: Jo filming her own movie from road-trip script! Photo: clapboard with dog sleeping in dog bed. Nate congrats; not surprised hard work paid off; asks more. Jo: every day on set awesome/full potential; showing vision awesome. Nate asks coolest moment. Jo: actor praised script; chills. Nate took turtles to beach in Tampa yesterday; they bring peace. Jo asks what loves most. Nate: calm, low maintenance, basking in sun. Nate: turtles like zen masters; remind slow down/appreciate small things. Nate experimenting flavors; coconut milk ice cream colorful bowls; offers recipe. Jo accepts; thanks. Jo: great catching up, take it easy.

Speakers: Nate and Joanna (“Jo”). Rolling summary.

Core: Jo writes screenplays/books; loves reading, movies, nature/hiking, journaling, memories, dairy-free baking. Severe pet allergy (reptiles/furry/cockroaches); had dog Tilly in Michigan but gave her away; keeps stuffed dog Nate gave, named Tilly, always with her while writing. Nate pro gamer (CS:GO, Valorant, Street Fighter, Nintendo RPGs), has turtles (now 3), loves dairy-free desserts, purple hair, Iron Man, Tampa. Mutual support; Jo gives movie recs; Nate encourages writing.

Timeline highlights:
- Jan-Feb 2022 (D1-D4): reconnected. Nate won first CS:GO tournament; Jo not into games. Jo writes/reads/movies/nature; Nate games/movies. Nate action/sci-fi/classics; Jo dramas/romcoms. Jo finished first full screenplay (drama/romance), plans festivals. Nate has turtles; recommends pets for stress. Jo severe pet allergy. Nate chill at tournaments, cheers even if loses. Nate discovered coconut milk ice cream; made dairy-free chocolate cake with berries. Jo dairy-free. Jo started script: 30-year-old woman’s self-discovery after loss, inspired by own story, road trip to heal/grow; Nate called deep.
- Mar-Apr (D5-D9): Jo wrapped 2nd script; audition for writing gig; joined writers group; script “Finding Home.” Nate tournaments; dyed hair purple. Turtles low-maintenance/calming; walking them reminds enjoy small stuff. Jo wished not allergic; would get two. Jo nature/hiking haven; found hometown trail. Nate: find peace/remember life’s beauty; pets/hobbies break reality. Jo writing advice: read lots, try genres, don’t fear writing/sharing, practice/feedback, follow dreams.
- May-Jun (D10-D15): Jo watched LOTR after Nate rec; hiking at Whispering Falls; wrote bits for screenplay shown on big screen. Nate won 2nd tournament; tried local Street Fighter; loves dairy-free desserts. Jo testing dairy-free desserts. Jo loves Spider-Man/Peter Parker; Nate Iron Man. Jo’s room: inspiring quotes/pictures.
- Jul-Aug (D17-D18): Nate won 4th online video game tournament; proud to make money doing what he loves. Jo road trip research to Woodhaven (small Midwest town: scenery, historic buildings, old library 1900s book stories/sketches) sparked next script; started book on loss/redemption/forgiveness. Nate: real-life stories best inspiration; sure she’ll be recognized as published movie author. Jo busy writing highs/lows; journal rock; words magical/healing; blog reader letter touched her. Nate teaching dairy-free dessert; offered creamy recipe; Jo would try/surprise family.
- Oct 2022 (D22-D25): D22 6 Oct: Jo’s raspberry tart dairy-free recipe winner; Nate won big video game tournament, made much money. D24 21 Oct: Nate stressed; turtles cheer him. Jo still has stuffed dog Tilly, helps focus/joy; real Tilly given away due allergy. Jo had rejection from production company; Nate: rejections don’t define her, keep at it, opportunity will come; Jo won’t slow down. D25 25 Oct: Jo contributed to another movie script shown on big screen; surreal/satisfying; shared drawing book of character visuals. Nate took turtles for walk; turtles eat vegetables/fruits/insects; loves seeing them hyped on strawberries.
- Nov 2022:
  - D26 4 Nov: details unavailable/truncated.
  - D27 7 Nov: Nate won final of big Valorant tournament last Saturday; best feeling seeing name as champion. Jo finished producer presentation last Friday—tough but looking good. Nate preparing other tournaments, busy/loving it; grateful for job. Jo writing another movie script—love story with challenges from a dream; submitted a few scripts last week; hopes at least one becomes her 3rd published movie. Nate upgraded home equipment (desk/monitor, headphones/controller). Jo asks favorite game; Nate playing fantasy RPG “Xeonoblade Chronicles,” recommends it; big Nintendo fan. Nate loves Jo’s movie recs more than random. Jo included handwritten letter from her brother as a kid in next script; sweet childhood memories. Nate: childhood memories powerful. Jo started writing favorite memories down. Nate will write down things animals like and favorite memories with Jo.
  - D28 9 Nov: Nate’s tournament pushed back; made homemade coconut ice cream, sprinkles changed color. Jo couldn’t try due dairy. Nate didn’t make finals; considering joining new gaming team after next tourney (offers, undecided). Jo: switch could open opportunities. Jo pitched another script to producers yesterday; they really liked it, big confidence boost. Jo’s new project: suspenseful thriller set in small Midwestern town; inspired by sunset hike near Fort Wayne last summer. Nate got third turtle; turtles bring joy/peace, tank big enough. Jo asked to come over and watch him play with them from a distance due allergy; Nate agreed, maybe watch her movie or park; will bathe turtles before. Jo: see you tomorrow. Nate: Bye Joanna.
  - D29 11 Nov 2022: Jo filming her own movie from road-trip script! Photo: clapboard with dog sleeping in dog bed. Nate congrats; not surprised hard work paid off; asks more. Jo: every day on set awesome/full potential; showing vision awesome. Nate asks coolest moment. Jo: actor praised script; chills. Nate took turtles to beach in Tampa yesterday; they bring peace. Nate experimenting flavors; coconut milk ice cream colorful bowls; offers recipe. Jo accepts; thanks. Jo: great catching up, take it easy.

John organizing sibling gaming night next month; siblings live far apart but plan gaming nights.

**S21 (26 Aug 2022, 9:18 pm):** James photo holding Ned on couch; Ned awesome since adoption. John helps younger siblings with programming; they’re making simple text-based adventure game; proud. **S23 (4 Sep 2022, 9:23 pm):** James at theater with Samantha; asked her to be his girlfriend; she agreed. Ups/downs but happy. John’s parents just started learning.

**S26 (3 Oct 2022):** prior summary truncated; details unavailable.

James’s mother visited with her army friend; friend still serving but retired long ago; stories/photo. **S31 (7 Nov 2022, 8:57 pm):** James on family road trip; visited friends Josh and Mark; great time; photo group. John had super fun weekend working with game developer; created online board game; ideas came to life; incredible. Demo about to release; excited for feedback; shared photo of wooden board game with four wood pieces/colored balls. James wants to support and give thoughts; keep posted. James visited animal sanctuary on way to Mark/Josh; many cute rescue dogs; thought of shared love of furry pals; photo man kneeling next to dog. Wanted to take all home but already has three dogs; more than three too much. John still hasn’t gotten a dog but wants one; asks what it’s like. James: furry friends bring joy/friendship; life wouldn’t be same; every day better; dogs make dark days better; unconditional love/positivity. James asks the pup’s name; John says “Luna”; image caption: photo of two people standing in front of a giant head. James says Luna’s a great name. John thanks, then has to go, apologizes, says “Cheers! Bye!” James signs off “Later! Take care!”

John: HTML/CSS; later coding blog, recommends Stormlight Archive, Kingkiller Chronicle, Expanse, “Name of the Wind.” Dogs Max, Daisy, Ned (adopted from Stamford shelter); Max playful/swimming/frisbee. John attended gaming convention/CS:GO tournament; James online tournament (semifinals), plays Apex Legends, later won online tournament. Travel: James Italy/Turkey/Mexico; John Japan; possible joint trip next year. James hikes with dogs. John frustrated coding; James advised small steps. John freelance; first website for local business. James loves Valhalla/Civ VI. Pizza: James pepperoni/cheese/prosciutto; John Hawaiian. John organized charity CS:GO tournament for dog shelter/homeless; volunteered programming; built foundation app; considered non-profit career. James finished big project; learned new language/patience/problem-solving. John got dream job. James started gaming/programming course; football simulator; Liverpool fan vs John’s Man City; bet Liverpool finish higher. James volunteered with charity; John asked to join; James agreed. John overwhelmed balancing personal/professional. James extreme sports: rope jumping 150m, surfing. James bought air tickets to Toronto, leaving day after tomorrow evening (as of 9 Jul 2022).

**S17 (22 Jul 2022, 9:49 am):** James’s trip great; visited Nuuk, added to bucket list; souvenirs for John and Jill; Jill delighted; photo with sister/two dogs; close bond with sister/furry friends like family; ocean sunset with sister. John grateful for siblings/support in tough times.

**S18 (6 Aug 2022, 1:45 pm):** John left IT job after 3 years; aligned values/passions; loves new job; wants gaming-industry career as state tournament organizer (CS:GO, Fortnite); has connections; plans experience/skills. James proud, offers financial advice/assistance. James took puppy to vet for routine exam and seasonal canine disease vaccination; puppy OK.

**S19 (10 Aug 2022, 9:16 am):** John thanks James for encouraging new genres; exploring strategy/RPG; playing Witcher 3; loves storytelling/characters/choices/immersion; considers competitions. James agrees. James took three dogs to beach; met Samantha, gave phone number; plans to call/ask out.

**S20 (21 Aug 2022, 3:57 pm):** John joined online programming group; community of skilled coders passionate about tech for good; collaborated; complementary strengths. Not returning to programming; focused on eSports. James has regular gaming group; streams; hosted all-night marathon. John bought new devices/refurbished gaming desk: chair, keyboard, graphics card, headset. Gaming = escape. John organizing sibling gaming night next month; siblings live far apart but plan gaming nights.

**S21 (26 Aug 2022, 9:18 pm):** James photo holding Ned on couch; Ned awesome since adoption. John helps younger siblings with programming; they’re making simple text-based adventure game; proud. James dreams of strategy game like Civilization. Agree meet McGee’s Pub tomorrow (27 Aug); John prefers light beer, dislikes dark.

**S22 (1 Sep 2022, 6:53 pm):** James’s Unity strategy game finished; proud; thanks John; screenshots; inspired by Civilization/Total War; challenges balancing mechanics/fairness; takeaways perseverance/patience/feedback/collaboration. John teaching siblings coding; fulfilling; they’re creating basic games/stories. John going through difficult times; James offers to talk/vent.

**S23 (4 Sep 2022, 9:23 pm):** James at theater with Samantha; asked her to be his girlfriend; she agreed. Ups/downs but happy. John’s parents just started learning.

**S24 (18 Sep 2022, 6:02 pm):** John into board games; tried “Dungeons of the Dragon.” James busy; writes to-dos in notebook; vivid dream of medieval castle with labyrinth puzzles/traps; sketches/notes.

**S25 (20 Sep 2022, 8:56 pm):** John’s week chaotic; started startup: portable smokers; welded one from metal; photo. James streamed game; nice comments from gaming community; inspired. John appreciates help; will make time for himself.

**S26 (3 Oct 2022):** prior summary truncated; details unavailable.

**S28 (21 Oct 2022, 7:36 pm):** James’s apartment lost power before big reveal; lost progress; will save more often. John organized programming seminar; great turnout; learned new approaches; will send James resources/tutorials. James’s mother visited with her army friend; friend still serving but retired long ago; stories/photo. James shares Nintendo console/Mario gamepad photo; first gaming system; Super Mario/Zelda sparked passion. James tried Cyberpunk 2077; great/addictive.

**S29 (31 Oct 2022, 12:37 am):** John held gaming tournament with buddies: Fortnite, Overwatch, Apex Legends; raised decent amount for children’s hospital; competitive/hyped. James praised. James and Samantha decided to move in together; rented apartment not far [prior summary truncated].

**S31 (7 Nov 2022, 8:57 pm):** James on family road trip; visited friends Josh and Mark; great time; photo group. John had super fun weekend working with game developer; created online board game; ideas came to life; incredible. Demo about to release; excited for feedback; shared photo of wooden board game with four wood pieces/colored balls. James wants to support and give thoughts; keep posted. James visited animal sanctuary on way to Mark/Josh; many cute rescue dogs; thought of shared love of furry pals; photo man kneeling next to dog. Wanted to take all home but already has three dogs; more than three too much. John still hasn’t gotten a dog but wants one; asks what it’s like. James: furry friends bring joy/friendship; life wouldn’t be same; every day better; dogs make dark days better; unconditional love/positivity. John agrees; dogs accept without judgment; special buddies; shares photo of cousin’s dog sitting on rug in front of couch. James asks the pup’s name; John says “Luna”; image caption: photo of two people standing in front of a giant head. James says Luna’s a great name. John thanks, then has to go, apologizes, says “Cheers! Bye!” James signs off “Later! Take care!”
